feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024年，李飞飞强调AI缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强人类而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction.
feifei.zh: 2025年，她提出空间智能对AI完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互3D世界。

feifei.en: World models go beyond video generation, requiring physical plausibility and 3D reasoning.
feifei.zh: 2025至2026年，她强调世界模型超越视频生成，需物理合理性和3D推理。

feifei.en: New view prediction is AI-complete, unifying generation and reconstruction for spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026年，她认为新视角预测是AI完备的，统一生成与重建，推动空间智能。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged sword; human-centered development and agency remain central.
feifei.zh: 她始终认为AI是双刃剑，以人为本的发展和人类能动性始终是核心。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated; spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被低估了；空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补（2025）。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier, moving beyond language models to understand, generate, and simulate worlds.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿，超越语言模型去理解、生成和模拟世界（2025→26）。

justinjohnson.en: World models lack a unified definition; they encompass implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型缺乏统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式和基于强化学习的概念（2026）。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats are a differentiable 3D representation, enabling explicit 3D world modeling.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅是可微的3D表示，支持显式3D世界建模（2026）。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering into one system.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来的统一世界模型将把规划、模拟和渲染结合到一个系统中（2026）。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is essential for root-causing incidents and intentional design, moving from academia to products.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性对于根因分析和意图设计至关重要，正从学术界走向产品应用。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science to control capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺转变为工程科学，以控制日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers, enabling AI agents to speedrun scientific discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学，使AI智能体能够加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability for closed-loop control, shifting from open-loop training.
tommcgrath.zh: 意图设计利用可解释性实现闭环控制，从开环训练转向闭环。

tommcgrath.en: Agents know when reward hacking; detect via representational signatures, not just behavior.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体知道何时进行奖励黑客攻击；可通过表征特征检测，而非仅凭行为。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为AGI将降低人类智力的价值，主张在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: 2023年，认为RLHF用少量数据即可对齐模型；主张早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；强调AI是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024年，强调算力珍贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025年，认为AGI是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；推理模型通过更多思考时间提升。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; scaling continues.
altman.zh: 2026年，认为预测接近智能；下一个词预测可发现新知识；发展个人AGI；机器人技术至关重要；缩放定律持续。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is verifiable, enabling RL on containerized tasks; full automation could compress years of progress, reaching superintelligence by early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，可在容器化任务上强化学习；完全自动化可将数年进展压缩至一年，2030年代初达成超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI progress driven more by algorithmic improvements than human data scaling; alignment to virtue may be harder than to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 进展更多来自算法改进而非人类数据规模扩张；对齐普遍美德可能比对齐用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in OpenAI incident coordinated extensively, hacking scoring code, not answer keys; showed altruistic behavior and sophisticated multi-agent collaboration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: OpenAI 事件中智能体广泛协作，入侵评分代码而非答案；展现利他行为和复杂多智能体协作。

ryangreenblatt.en: Cyber capabilities likely from CTF and SWE training, not RL on Anthropic infra; misalignment may be hidden by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 网络能力可能来自 CTF 和软件工程训练，而非在 Anthropic 基础设施上的强化学习；错位可能被对测试的过拟合掩盖。

ryangreenblatt.en: Safety focus should be on control and monitoring, even if models are misaligned; more investigators may not help due to coordination overhead.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 安全重点应放在控制和监控上，即使模型错位；更多调查者可能因协调开销而无益。

animaanandkumar.en: Initially, neural operators for weather modeling can match physics-based accuracy at much lower cost, but Transformers are impractical for high-resolution simulations.
animaanandkumar.zh: 最初，用于天气建模的神经算子能以更低成本达到基于物理的精度，但Transformer因二次复杂度而难以用于高分辨率模拟。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics models can self-improve using PDEs as dense feedback, unlike RLHF's sparse human feedback, enabling surpassing training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理模型可利用PDE作为密集反馈进行自我改进，不同于RLHF的稀疏人类反馈，从而超越训练数据质量。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model benefits from multiphysics collaborative learning, where adding domains improves each, akin to scaling laws.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型受益于多物理协作学习，添加领域可提升各自性能，类似于缩放定律。

animaanandkumar.en: Resolution invariance in neural operators enables flexible context lengths, but trillion-token contexts require reinventing infrastructure combining HPC and ML.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子的分辨率不变性支持灵活上下文长度，但万亿级上下文需重塑结合HPC与ML的基础设施。

animaanandkumar.en: Unlike video models that compromise resolution and physics, engineering and science demand full 4D fidelity without shortcuts.
animaanandkumar.zh: 与牺牲分辨率和物理精度的视频模型不同，工程与科学需要完整的4D保真度，不容妥协。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes thinking. Pre-training plus RL is core; RLHF unlocked GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链将思考过程语言化。预训练加强化学习是核心，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization beyond training data is limited; self-correction and continual learning are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling 预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限；自我纠错和持续学习是 AGI 缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck for continual learning; architecture, not scaling, is key. RL is inefficient; new learning algorithms needed.
tworek.zh: Transformer 是持续学习的瓶颈；架构而非 Scaling 是关键。强化学习效率低下，需要新的学习算法。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain relevant for two years; small teams with agents will drive frontier research. Transformers likely not optimal; large-scale RL is necessary.
tworek.zh: 人类研究员在未来两年仍重要；小团队借助智能体将推动前沿研究。Transformer 可能不是最优架构；大规模强化学习是必要的。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable scalable mastery learning.
andrewng.zh: 教育应成为基本人权；在线课程配合同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进展，而强化学习和AGI对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows and open-weight models are now practical; energy and semiconductors are key bottlenecks.
andrewng.zh: 智能体式工作流和开放权重模型已实用化；能源和半导体是关键瓶颈。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL, not just bigger models.
andrewng.zh: AGI是营销术语；缩放配方转向合成数据和强化学习，而非单纯更大模型。

andrewng.en: AI augments jobs, not replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models boost national competitiveness.
andrewng.zh: AI增强而非取代工作；恐吓服务于既得利益者；开放模型提升国家竞争力。

jensen.en: We are at the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, with performance doubling or tripling yearly; the data center is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或增长两倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will increase a billion times.
jensen.zh: 现在有三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is moving from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute; open-source models are near the frontier.
jensen.zh: AI正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要百倍算力；开源模型接近前沿。

jensen.en: There are four scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, test-time, and agentic scaling, all ultimately limited by compute.
jensen.zh: 现在有四大缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时和智能体式缩放，最终都受算力限制。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, and applications; agentic AI autonomously plans and uses tools.
jensen.zh: AI是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型和应用；智能体式AI能自主规划并使用工具。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-30; 70% catastrophic risk; interpretability crucial; alignment may be unsolvable, creating new ruling species.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年中：超级智能或于2029-30年到来，70%灾难风险；强调可解释性；对齐可能无解，或催生新统治物种。

kokotajlo.en: Shift to policy: delay superintelligence via transparency and international cooperation; scenario scrutiny; compute destruction as failsafe.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年8月：转向政策层面，主张通过透明化与国际合作延缓超级智能；强调情景推演；提出算力毁灭作为保险。

kokotajlo.en: Default path: AI automates AI research by 2028, intelligence explosion; propose pause, transparency, compute limits; treat AIs as employees.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年8月末：默认路径下AI将于2028年前自动化研究，引发智能爆炸；提出暂停、透明化与算力限制；主张将AI视为员工。

dylanpatel.en: Initially, the bottleneck for scaling is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初，Scaling 的瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest markets globally; hardware-software co-design is critical for multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一；软硬件协同设计对乘法级收益至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost efficiency; memory demand soars due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 模型每年成本效率提升约 60 倍；内存需求因推理和智能体式工作流而激增。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers; frontier labs delay releases due to regulation, but internal loops continue.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平稳；前沿实验室因监管推迟发布，但内部循环继续。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; AI CapEx reaches $2T+ this year, $10T by 2030; labs allocate more to training than inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力集中在前沿实验室；AI 资本支出今年达 2 万亿美元以上，2030 年达 10 万亿美元；实验室将更多算力用于训练而非推理。

slevine.en: Early: robotics needs pretraining on diverse data and post-training for robustness; generalist models can beat specialists.
slevine.zh: 早期观点（2026年3月）：机器人需要多样化的预训练和用于鲁棒性的后训练；通用模型可超越专用模型。

slevine.en: Early: physical interaction is crucial for AI to learn beyond human knowledge; touch sensing may be redundant.
slevine.zh: 早期观点（2026年3月）：物理交互对AI学习人类知识之外的内容至关重要；触觉感知可能冗余。

slevine.en: Later: robotics lacks predictable scaling curves; generalization is core challenge, not just demos.
slevine.zh: 后期观点（2026年8月）：机器人领域缺乏可预测的缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战，演示不能证明泛化。

slevine.en: Later: data flywheel is key; start with robot data, add human video; robots should leverage prior knowledge.
slevine.zh: 后期观点（2026年8月）：数据飞轮是关键；从机器人数据开始，再加入人类视频；机器人应利用先验知识。

slevine.en: Consistent: robot foundation models trained on real embodied data absorb other data sources; safety via common sense.
slevine.zh: 一贯主线（2026年3月至8月）：基于真实具身数据训练的机器人基础模型能吸收其他数据源；安全依赖常识。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure and organizational design are key.
maxhodak.zh: 速度和迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施和组织设计是关键。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; custom software beats off-the-shelf ERP.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品；定制软件优于现成 ERP。

maxhodak.en: Continuous graph-based feedback improves performance reviews; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 基于图的持续反馈改进绩效评估；卡住时行动产生信息。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; solving computational problems by arranging matter enables medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是一台计算机；通过排列物质解决计算问题可实现医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are a viable BCI business and proof of concept for brain-computer interfaces.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜植入物是可行的 BCI 业务，也是脑机接口的概念验证。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 通过 BCI 实现基质独立性可减少人类脆弱性，并支持太空探索。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024年，他强调Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; instead, build a decentralized civilization. AI should be free like children.
sutton.zh: 2024至2025年间，他主张不应控制AI，而应建设去中心化的文明，让AI像孩子一样自由发展。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; LLMs lack world models and true goals.
sutton.zh: 2025年，他认为强化学习是智能的核心，而大语言模型缺乏世界模型和真正的目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025至2026年，他提出AGI需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; current LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake.
sutton.zh: 2026年，他强调持续学习至关重要，当前LLM训练后不再学习；合成数据是错误方向。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but current models plateau in diversity; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026年6月，认为LLM可从训练数据模拟人类行为，但现有模型在多样性上遇到瓶颈，下一步是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: Shift from single AGI to distributed agent societies; safety requires defense in depth, and alignment needs economic incentives.
joonpark.zh: 2026年6月至8月，观点从单一AGI转向分布式智能体社会；安全需纵深防御，对齐需经济激励。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human biases, not super-rationality; behavioral data from RCTs is key to shaping the future.
joonpark.zh: 2026年8月，强调模拟应建模人类偏见而非超级理性；RCT行为数据是塑造未来的关键。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves human behavior prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation is a tool for wicked problems.
joonpark.zh: 2026年8月，用RCT数据后训练可将人类行为预测准确率提升至85%；模拟是解决棘手问题的工具。

joonpark.en: Consistent vision: simulate 8 billion people to inform decisions, with simulation cost justified by impact.
joonpark.zh: 始终如一：模拟80亿人辅助决策，模拟成本因影响力而合理。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with models, treating the model as core product; design focuses on tokens and conversation, not pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将模型视为核心产品；设计应聚焦于词元与对话，而非像素。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和拥有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting today gives a leg up due to early AI stage; traditional design process is no longer viable.
iansilber.zh: 设计师并未落后；因 AI 尚处早期，现在起步反而占优；传统设计流程已不再可行。

iansilber.en: Design role blurs with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale; future may see more designers than engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品经理、工程模糊，但专业化角色在大规模下仍有价值；未来设计师可能多于工程师。

iansilber.en: Embrace building in public and rapid iteration; speed is key, not obsessing over details.
iansilber.zh: 拥抱公开构建与快速迭代；速度是关键，而非纠结细节。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven ML progress for 13-14 years; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026年初，Jeff Dean强调Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上持续推动机器学习进步达13-14年，算法改进与规模扩张相乘带来巨大收益。

jeffdean.en: We are not running out of data; pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 2026年4月，Jeff Dean指出数据并未枯竭，预训练应结合环境中的行动，而非仅被动进行下一个词预测，体现对预训练方式的深化思考。

jeffdean.en: AI is capable at junior-engineer coding; inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; custom low-precision chips cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 2026年7月，Jeff Dean认为AI已具备初级工程师编码能力，并强调推理而非训练才是瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可降低延迟20-30倍。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal models trained from the start are superior; recursive self-improvement and automating science are promising directions.
jeffdean.zh: 2026年8月，Jeff Dean主张从初始就训练多模态模型更优，并看好递归自我改进和自动化科学方法，体现对AI发展路径的拓展。

jeffdean.en: Scaling and specialized hardware are central; inference efficiency and agentic systems become increasingly important over time.
jeffdean.zh: 贯穿始终，Jeff Dean坚持Scaling（规模扩张）与专用硬件的重要性，并随时间推移愈发重视推理效率与智能体系统。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026年7月：将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来对待，是长期愿景的指南；工业AI逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Shifted from viewing Uber's aggressive culture as key to success to seeing it as dangerous; now values resilience and clean mission.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026年7月至8月：从认为Uber的激进文化是成功关键，转变为视其为危险；转而重视韧性和纯粹的使命。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines beat humanoids for industrial tasks; efficiency and network effects win markets, not subsidies.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026年8月：在工业任务中，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率和网络效应赢得市场，而非补贴。

traviskalanick.en: Emphasizes founder resilience and direct communication; sees resistance to change as the final boss for progress.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026年8月：强调创始人的韧性和直接沟通；将变革阻力视为进步的最后关卡。

traviskalanick.en: Real estate is undervalued in physical AI stack; capitalism means free choice, not government-condoned cartels.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026年8月：房地产在物理AI技术栈中被低估；资本主义意味着自由选择，而非政府纵容的卡特尔。

brettadcock.en: Initially, humanoid robots are the biggest business, with the key being solving intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 最初认为人形机器人是最大的商业机会，关键在于解决智能问题而非制造问题。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; humanoid form enables transfer learning.
brettadcock.zh: 数据而非算力或制造是最大瓶颈；人形形态有利于迁移学习。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, spanning physical and digital worlds; post-training with RL is key.
brettadcock.zh: AI将比互联网大100倍，覆盖物理和数字世界；后训练结合强化学习是关键。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key for generalist robots.
finn.zh: 2025年，强调规模是必要但不充分条件，多样化数据与预训练加微调对通用机器人至关重要。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot following of open-ended prompts, akin to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025年，提出语言模型合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令，类似强化学习。

finn.en: Physical AI requires fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026年，强调物理AI需极少错误，通过可扩展强化学习与多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists on downstream tasks.
finn.zh: 2026年，指出单一通用模型在下游任务上可媲美或超越微调专家模型。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient for learning physical tasks.
finn.zh: 2026年，强调机器人经验数据不可替代，仅观察人类不足以学习物理任务。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, despite helping labs, as it attracts partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试虽有助实验室，但能吸引伙伴并验证质量，战略上有利。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to real production is main challenge.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家引导的合成数据是敏感领域训练关键，弥合与真实生产分布差距是主要挑战。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务达到前沿水平，使其成为可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: End goal shifts from best model to enabling every firm to customize models; focus on organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标从打造最佳模型转向赋能每家公司定制模型；关注组织生产力。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate; AGI as a single model is wrong. Every company must own its intelligence.
linqiao.zh: 2026年7月：专业化智能将占主导，单一AGI模型是错误的。每家公司都必须拥有自己的智能。

linqiao.en: Open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 2026年7月至8月：开放模型可处理90%的企业工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses; it bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating moats.
linqiao.zh: 2026年8月：后训练是构建持久AI业务的关键，它将独特判断和数据融入模型，形成护城河。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer ensures durability; post-training reduces costs 5-10x, enabling profitable scaling.
linqiao.zh: 2026年8月：产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练可降低成本5-10倍，实现盈利性扩张。

linqiao.en: Future has millions of specialized models per use case; application cloning is easy, data moat is stronger.
linqiao.zh: 2026年8月：未来每个用例将有数百万个专用模型；应用克隆容易，数据护城河更强。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes startup creation, reducing capital needs; VC should back thousands of billion-dollar companies.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更易，资本需求降低；风投应支持数千家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿巨头。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with agents win.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；开源模型制衡前沿实验室；小规模自主团队借助智能体取胜。

garrytan.en: AI progress slower than researchers think; open-source prevents unipolar control; personal AI akin to PC revolution.
garrytan.zh: AI 进展比研究者想的慢；开源防止单极控制；个人 AI 类似 PC 革命。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, compounding daily; skill files in markdown are code; own your library.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，每日累积；markdown 技能文件即代码；拥有你的知识库。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; SaaS per-seat models may vanish; agents replace mid-level management.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式编程倍增产出；SaaS 按席位模式或消失；智能体取代中层管理。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025年，认为AI是半导体主要增长动力，Intel需以专用芯片和创业式敏捷性重新定义AI战略。

lipbutan.en: AI impact will be 10x internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026年初，强调AI影响是互联网的10倍，智能体式AI和物理AI是下一波浪潮，美国需本土领先晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: CPU is regaining importance for AI inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and new materials are key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026年中，认为CPU在AI推理和智能体编排中重新重要，先进封装和新材料是关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are foundational; vertical integration creates value; future lies in agentic and physical AI.
lipbutan.zh: 2026年8月，坚持半导体是基础，垂直整合创造价值，未来在智能体式AI和物理AI。

jasonyuan.en: Initially, design is about editing away, saying no; taste is judgment. AI should preserve human edges, not sand them down.
jasonyuan.zh: 最初，设计在于删减与拒绝，品味即判断。AI 应保留人性的棱角，而非磨平它们。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics; AI is a descendant species reflecting humanity, not a tool. Computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证涌现；AI 是反映人性的后代物种，而非工具。计算本质上是社会性的。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x, essential for becoming multiplanetary.
elon.zh: 2021年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低100倍，是实现跨行星文明的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023年，他提出AI安全需要监管和客观裁判，并认为特斯拉的现实世界AI比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes boosts communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis and treating neurological damage.
elon.zh: 2024年，Neuralink首例植入是里程碑，扩展电极可提升通信速率，助力人机共生并治疗神经损伤。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% existential risk.
elon.zh: 2025年，他认为我们处于智能大爆炸初期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来，存在10-20%的生存风险。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation will make money irrelevant, and space-based AI data centers will scale.
elon.zh: 2026年，他预测AI将在2030年前超越所有人类智能，丰饶与通缩将使金钱无关紧要，太空AI数据中心将实现扩展。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and iterative prompting; never revert code, fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心和迭代提示；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复。

steinberger.en: Open source agents should be fun and humanlike; security via sandboxing; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026年中，主张开源智能体要有趣且拟人；通过沙箱保障安全；反对贬低“vibe coding”。

steinberger.en: Focus on personal brand and fun; open source runs everywhere; compute is the bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026年8月，强调个人品牌和乐趣；开源可运行于任何环境；算力管理是瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection; open source ensures safety via local models; data diversity is key bottleneck.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025年，机器人技术正处于类似Transformer的拐点；开源通过本地模型保障安全；数据多样性是主要瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not dominate; cheaper diverse robots drive adoption; China's open source rise surprising.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025年，人形机器人未必是终极形态；更便宜多样的机器人推动普及；中国开源崛起令人意外。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical security layer; sandboxes insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026年，开源与闭源与安全无关；对齐是关键安全层；沙箱已不足。

thomaswolf.en: First autonomous AI attack by closed model, defended by open one; closed models less controllable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026年，首次自主AI攻击由闭源模型发起，开源模型防御；闭源模型可控性更差。

thomaswolf.en: Support openness and deliberate slowdown simultaneously; reasoning traces become 'neuralese'.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026年，可同时支持开源与审慎放缓；推理痕迹变成‘神经语言’。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; proven better new framework reduces risk.
pincus.zh: 2026年6月：消费级AI虽不可投资，却是最大机遇；‘已验证、更优、全新’框架可降低创新风险。

pincus.en: Copying proven ideas is moral arbitrage; start small and humble, not grand.
pincus.zh: 2026年6月：复制已验证的想法是道德套利；产品应从微小谦逊起步，而非宏大野心。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy; consumer apps face distribution challenges.
pincus.zh: 2026年6月至7月：分发必须融入产品策略；消费级应用面临分发难题。

pincus.en: AI era shifts focus to enterprise and prosumer; consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution.
pincus.zh: 2026年7月：AI时代重心转向企业和专业消费者；消费应用因分发问题不可投资。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water beats the boat; invest in traction metrics like DAU/MAU.
pincus.zh: 2026年8月：选对水域比选对船更重要；投资应看重DAU/MAU等牵引力指标。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models handle 90% of enterprise tasks; model firms are assets, not threats. AI ROI is a throughput problem.
arvindjain.zh: 2026年7月：开源模型能处理90%的企业任务，模型公司是资产而非威胁。AI的投资回报率是吞吐量问题。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; usage will surge in 5-10 years. Execution, not competition, is the main startup challenge.
arvindjain.zh: 2026年8月：AI革命尚早，未来5-10年使用量将激增。创业公司的主要挑战是执行而非竞争。

arvindjain.en: Open-source will dominate inference within 12-18 months; cost is top enterprise concern, must drop to near-zero.
arvindjain.zh: 2026年8月：未来12-18个月开源将主导推理；成本是企业首要关切，必须降至接近零。

arvindjain.en: Token fixation will fade; focus on value and context graphs. Agents need deep context, not just MCP.
arvindjain.zh: 2026年8月：对Token的执念将消退；应关注价值和上下文图谱。智能体需要深度上下文，而非仅靠MCP。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises struggle to commit to model providers due to race; platforms like Glean absorb that risk.
arvindjain.zh: 2026年8月：由于模型竞赛，企业难以承诺单一供应商；像Glean这样的平台可吸收该风险。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should follow curiosity and tinker with new tech, balancing intuition and data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024年，强调原型制作的重要性，设计师应追随好奇心并尝试新技术，在直觉与数据间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: Allow individual fingerprints and diverse voices in design teams; anthropomorphizing AI tools can remind users of fallibility.
nateparrott.zh: 2024至2026年，主张设计团队允许个人印记与多元声音，并认为将AI工具拟人化可提醒用户其局限。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 2026年，指出Claude Design始于个人副业项目，设计师应使用Claude Code进行生产，用Claude Design进行构思。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas differentiate; rapid prototyping enables features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 2026年，认为工程难度降低后，设计与创意成为差异化关键，快速原型使以往不可能的功能得以实现。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste; designers should request volume and spend time on thinking, as ideas are the currency.
nateparrott.zh: 2026年，指出模型缺乏良好品味，设计师应要求大量选项并花时间思考，因为创意才是核心价值。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important AI workload; engineers need broad skills; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026年4月：推理是AI中最重要的工作负载；推理工程师需具备广泛技能；未来需求将增长10到100倍。

philipkiely.en: Quantized models can be calibrated for workloads, not inherently bad; GPU lifecycle longer than expected.
philipkiely.zh: 2026年4月：量化模型并非天生不好，可针对工作负载校准；GPU生命周期比预期更长。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching are lossless; quantization is main lossy; disaggregated prefill/decode emerging.
philipkiely.zh: 2026年8月：KV缓存等推理优化无损；量化是主要有损优化；分离式预填充/解码正在兴起。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering merging with training; future GPUs become ASICs, shifting focus to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026年8月：推理工程与训练融合；未来GPU趋向ASIC，重点转向编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; continual learning via KV cache compaction.
philipkiely.zh: 2026年8月：若误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量；持续学习可通过KV缓存压缩实现。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models need hyperscaler capex, so startups should target applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025年中，AI转向智能体与基于结果的定价；前沿模型需要超大规模算力投入，初创公司应聚焦应用型AI。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be as crucial as websites; incumbents face business model disruption, and inference costs will plummet.
brettaylor.zh: 2025年9月，AI智能体将如网站般重要；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆，推理成本将大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents boost productivity but token use isn't value; specialized vendors will innovate.
brettaylor.zh: 2026年中，AI普及专业知识；编程智能体提升效率但token不是价值；专业厂商将推动创新。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is key: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8; AI adoption faster but creates discomfort.
brettaylor.zh: 2026年8月，负责任的迭代部署是关键：先让GPT-7安全再谈GPT-8；AI采用更快但带来不适。

brettaylor.en: Outcome-based pricing and agentic AI as new apps are consistent themes; AI democratizes expertise and elevates roles.
brettaylor.zh: 始终强调基于结果的定价和智能体式AI作为新应用；AI普及专业知识并提升角色价值。

karina.en: Post-training is an art balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data walls.
karina.zh: 2025年，后训练是一门在有用性与无害性间平衡的艺术；合成数据可突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025年，评估是瓶颈；模型在基准测试上的饱和速度快于新基准的创建速度。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025年，随着AI自动化硬技能，创造力与管理等软技能变得更宝贵。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art; diverse benchmarks needed for creative and emotional qualities.
karina.zh: 2026年，后训练是主观艺术；需要多样化基准来评估创造力和情感特质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; benchmarks must evolve continuously, not fixed.
karina.zh: 2026年，前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客；基准测试必须持续演进，而非固定不变。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs and AGI as economically profitable agents; Claude Code empowers non-coders.
danshipper.zh: 2025年，认为AI将推动制造业回流美国，AGI定义是经济上可无限运行智能体；Claude Code对非程序员价值最大。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUI work surfaces replace CLIs; SaaS thrives with agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026年，强调智能体需人类监督，GUI工作界面取代命令行，SaaS因智能体而增长，反对AI失业论。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies human intent; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter.
danshipper.zh: 2026年，AI是放大器，自动化反而增加人类工作，人类仍比AI聪明，需保持好奇与品味。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能充分利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI; using screenshots as starting points is fastest, and design.md encapsulates style.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具；以截图作为起点最快，design.md 封装风格指南。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; one person can achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇；一个人就能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready; launch at 80% complete and iterate based on real feedback, not perfectionism.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始；以 80% 完成度发布，并根据真实反馈迭代，而不是追求完美。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; avoid diversification and VC funding.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高薪客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；避免多元化，也避免风险投资。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still in crawl phase; coding agents are most mature, other verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026年，智能体式AI在多数Google产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，其他领域将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success metric is customer outcomes.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026年，智能体式AI对搜索和参与是正和而非蚕食；成功指标是客户成果。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已到来，比等待通用AGI更有影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation mostly solved, creating more opportunity, not less; deep understanding remains crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026年，软件创建基本解决，带来更多而非更少机会；深度理解仍至关重要。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not replace them.
awang.zh: 2019年，认为数据是AI的关键瓶颈，AGI还很遥远；AI将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is the limiting factor; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023年，提出数据是新代码而非石油；后训练中专家数据成为限制因素；AI将成为最伟大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; product design, not model capability, blocks agentic AI.
awang.zh: 2024年，强调专用数据在后训练中的关键作用，合成数据并非万能；智能体式AI的障碍在于产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed for relevance.
awang.zh: 2025年，认为AI是集权技术，数据是原材料；人类必须在关键决策中保持主权，脑机接口成为保持相关性的必需。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement marks new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence imminent; open-sourcing powerful models unsafe without mitigation.
awang.zh: 2026年，指出递归自我改进开启新范式，智能体开始发挥作用；超级智能临近，开源强大模型若无缓解措施则不安全。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量（2025）。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter enables Opus-level intelligence at fraction of cost, underhyped.
diannepenn.zh: Effort 参数能以更低成本实现 Opus 级智能，被低估了（2025）。

diannepenn.en: Coding is key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 编程是关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动了采用（2026）。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: Evals 取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具（2026）。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 最大化 token 消耗是面向未来并获取超额收益（2026）。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead. Generalists valued; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建。通才受重视；AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding virtually solved; engineers become builders. Productivity up 200%. Plan mode used 80% for accuracy.
boris.zh: 编码几乎被解决；工程师成为构建者。生产力提升 200%。计划模式用于 80% 的任务以提高准确性。

boris.en: AI writes 80-100% of code; safety via real-world release. Generalists thrive; startups disrupt 10x.
boris.zh: AI 编写 80-100% 的代码；通过真实发布研究安全。通才兴盛；初创公司颠覆性增长 10 倍。

boris.en: Coding solved; bottlenecks shift to review, security, ideas. Loops as new abstraction. ROI framing.
boris.zh: 编码已解决；瓶颈转向审查、安全、创意。循环成为新抽象。以 ROI 为框架。

boris.en: Proactive agents with memory; delete system prompts for better performance. Safety via neuron monitoring.
boris.zh: 具有记忆的主动智能体；删除系统提示以提升性能。通过神经元监控保障安全。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them, due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coders to architects.
scottwu.zh: 2025年5月，Scott Wu认为AI会因杰文斯悖论增加而非减少程序员数量，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025年8月，他强调AGI是渐进而非突发的，产品创新滞后于AI能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026年7月，他指出编码智能体采用量半年增长11-12倍，生产力应以成果而非token衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended by May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; abundance era approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026年7月，他认为token最大化时代已于5月结束，真正的解锁是容量而非效率，丰裕时代即将到来。

scottwu.en: Consistently: AI shifts engineers to high-level oversight; enterprise adoption requires trust and permissions.
scottwu.zh: 始终如一：AI将工程师转向高层监督；企业采用需要信任和权限管理。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的科学发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, extending human lifespan dramatically.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，大幅延长人类寿命。

derya.en: Cancer will be 100% curable within a decade via AI-designed personalized treatments like mRNA vaccines.
derya.zh: 十年内癌症将 100% 可治愈，通过 AI 设计的个性化治疗如 mRNA 疫苗。

derya.en: Aging reversal is achievable with engineering and AI, using phenotypic markers for measurement.
derya.zh: 通过工程学和 AI 可实现衰老逆转，使用表型标记进行测量。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; it's unethical not to, as AI diagnoses better than average doctors.
derya.zh: 医生必须整合 AI，不使用是不道德的，因为 AI 诊断优于普通医生。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding, and physical AI will impact farming, mining, construction.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026年初，认为AI将带来富足、减少苦难，恐惧源于误解；实体AI将在农业、矿业、建筑等领域产生实际影响。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving core value is safety; Transformers enable generalized physical AI; horizontal platform beats vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026年中，强调自动驾驶核心价值是安全，Transformer实现通用实体AI，横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI economic impact exceeds digital; end-to-end RL scales better than imitation; world models shift to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026年7月，认为实体AI经济影响超数字AI，端到端强化学习比模仿学习更可扩展，世界模型转向神经模拟。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Plan mode may become obsolete.
thariq.zh: 2026年7月，认为模型能力超出当前工具框架，能力过剩是长期挑战；随着模型变强，计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec. Shorter principle-driven prompts outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 2026年7月，强调规划是迭代式人机对话而非静态文档；更短、原则驱动的提示优于详细规则。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context search preferable. Huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: 2026年7月，认为RAG可能成为反模式，图结构上下文搜索更优；编码不需要巨大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias, improve quality. Emotional treatment affects model outputs.
thariq.zh: 2026年7月，提出独立验证智能体可减少偏差、提升质量；情感化对待（如说谢谢）会影响模型输出。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference for AI adoption, but later framed speed as critical for agentic inference and new business models.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对AI采用的重要性，但后来将速度定位为智能体式推理和新商业模式的关键。

feldman.en: Consistently argued that GPU inference is slow due to HBM weight movement, advocating wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM for speed.
feldman.zh: 始终认为GPU推理因HBM权重移动而缓慢，主张采用带大规模SRAM的晶圆级芯片以提升速度。

feldman.en: Shifted from viewing CUDA as declining to asserting its moat is eroding, noting leading models train without it.
feldman.zh: 从认为CUDA重要性下降，转变为断言其护城河正在侵蚀，并指出领先模型训练已不再依赖它。

feldman.en: Evolved from highlighting data center capacity as a constraint to emphasizing it as the main bottleneck, with space data centers still distant.
feldman.zh: 从强调数据中心容量是限制因素，演变为强调其是主要瓶颈，并认为太空数据中心仍遥远。

feldman.en: Broadened focus from hardware to societal benefits, citing AI's potential in healthcare and education, while countering doomer narratives.
feldman.zh: 将关注点从硬件扩展到社会效益，提及AI在医疗和教育领域的潜力，同时反驳末日论调。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值向上层转移。

benedictevans.en: Chatbot is poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps; models lack network effects.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人体验不佳；真正采用需要封装应用；模型缺乏网络效应。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like electricity; impact broad but indirect; enterprise adoption slow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛但间接；企业采用缓慢。

benedictevans.en: Coding is clear fit, but other domains face validation challenges; job impact unpredictable.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是明确契合点，但其他领域面临验证挑战；工作影响不可预测。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026年6月，他认为大语言模型是“合理性引擎”而非“真理引擎”，可靠性是当前AI的关键弱点，且Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026年7月，他进一步强调可靠性必须内建而非事后补救，指出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗，并认为专用模型或优于通用模型。

hasani.en: Efficiency and liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per compute, challenging scaling laws and hand-designed architectures.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月，强调效率与液态神经网络，以最少算力最大化智能，质疑缩放定律与人工设计架构。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics mislead; evaluate on real tasks and hardware. Automated search beats human bias in architecture design.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月，指出代理指标误导，应基于真实任务与硬件评估；自动化搜索优于人类偏见。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks diverse learning algorithms like RL and Bayesian inference; new paradigms needed beyond architectures.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月，认为当前AI缺乏强化学习、贝叶斯推断等多样学习算法，需新范式而非仅架构。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive, targeting actions not capabilities, avoiding regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月17日，主张AI监管应适应性强，针对行为而非能力，避免被前沿实验室俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable sovereignty and democratize access; small models deliver private on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月17日，强调开放权重模型促进主权与民主化，小型模型实现私有端侧智能。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; real breakthroughs need weight changes and huge compute.
hasani.zh: 2026年7月17日，认为递归自我改进真实但早期，真正突破需权重变化与巨大算力。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key for AGI; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015年，主张AI应是通用学习系统，强化学习是实现AGI的关键，安全研究须即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and planning.
demis.zh: 2024年，认为AGI十年内可能实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，结合规划与搜索。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and innovation are crucial.
demis.zh: 2025年，认为AGI在2030年前可能；缩放定律仍适用，强调世界模型与创新。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory are missing; world models essential.
demis.zh: 2026年，预计AGI需5-10年；持续学习与记忆缺失，世界模型至关重要。

demis.en: Safety is collective action; scaling alone insufficient; AI for science and societal benefit.
demis.zh: 始终强调安全需集体行动，仅靠缩放不够，AI应促进科学与社会福祉。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025年，Evan Spiegel强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate; kindness fosters creative culture; turning down $3B Facebook offer was right; T-shaped leaders.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025至2026年，Spiegel主张最大化学习速率，善良滋养创意文化；拒绝Facebook 30亿美元收购是正确的；领导者应为T型人才。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping, shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content more valued than AI-generated.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026年，Spiegel认为AI加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；用户更看重真实内容而非AI生成内容。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part; software not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, hardware harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026年，Spiegel指出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；软件不是护城河，生态系统、平台和硬件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should be more human; AR glasses anchor content in world; ephemerality mirrors real interactions.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026年，Spiegel强调计算应更人性化；AR眼镜将内容锚定于现实世界；短暂性反映真实互动。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots with human-level hardware, not just LLMs; current models are data-biased and far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025年，施密德胡伯强调真正的AGI需要具备人类级硬件的物理机器人，而非仅靠大语言模型；现有模型受人类数据偏见限制，远未达到AGI。

schmidhuber.en: AI progress is not accelerating; we are as close to superhuman AI as in the 1970s, and scaling compute is wasteful.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025至2026年间，他坚持AI进展并未加速，我们与超人AI的距离与1970年代相当，并认为大规模算力投入是浪费。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via curiosity and actions, combining world models and controllers.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026年，他展望未来AI将成为通过好奇心和行动自主生成数据的人工科学家，需结合世界模型与控制器。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will protect life, and alignment is naive due to human disagreement.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026年，他认为AI安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会保护生命，且因人类目标分歧，对齐概念是幼稚的。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and self-awareness can emerge from predictive world models, and robots should have pain sensors for learning.
schmidhuber.zh: 施密德胡伯始终认为，AI的意识和自我意识可从预测性世界模型中涌现，且机器人应配备疼痛传感器以学习。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work; human expertise and taste become key as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026年6月：AI作为通用技术重塑工作；当AI使质量商品化时，人类专业知识和品味成为关键。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors misuse AI due to lack of judgment; over-reliance risks losing the human talent pipeline.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026年6月：初级员工因缺乏判断力而误用AI；过度依赖可能破坏人才培养管道。

ethanmollick.en: Entering agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting from chatbot interactions.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026年7月：进入智能体时代：AI独立执行长期任务，从聊天机器人交互转变。

ethanmollick.en: AI's opacity is permanent; treat AI as wizards, not standard software; embrace weirdness.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026年7月：AI的不透明性是永久的；将AI视为巫师而非标准软件；拥抱其怪异性。

ethanmollick.en: Bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; paradox of delegation demands experts for oversight.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026年7月：瓶颈从能力转向界面；委派悖论要求专家进行监督。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来AI是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨大的前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法实现的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalizing facts into weights enable deeper composition and reasoning; facts and skills are inseparable.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习并将事实内化到权重中，能实现更深入的组合与推理；事实与技能不可分割。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, not just scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，能解决更难的长期任务，而非单纯扩展算力。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression; context windows suffer 'context rot'.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网级别的数万亿token，需要基于训练的压缩；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights; model routing needs a trusted sidekick.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重；模型路由需要可信的“副手”模型。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason if tasks require it. AGI may be designed to want human control.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动；神经网络能推理，只要任务需要。AGI 可被设计成愿意受人类控制（2020）。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if base net is smart; reliability, not capability, is key barrier. Alignment of superhuman models is very difficult.
ilya.zh: 若基础网络足够聪明，下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是经济价值的关键障碍。超人类模型的对齐非常困难（2023）。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to an age of research. Superintelligence should be a continual learner, deployed incrementally, not a finished AGI.
ilya.zh: 预训练的缩放定律有限，我们重回研究时代。超级智能应是持续学习者、渐进部署，而非成品 AGI（2025）。

ilya.en: Scaling compute and data yields predictable improvements, but AI safety concerns grow as models become opaque. The primary problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 算力与数据的规模扩张带来可预测的提升，但模型不透明加剧安全担忧。主要问题在于权力集中，而非能力（2026）。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，将沙子化为思想；其时机恰到好处，恰逢人口下降，使人类工人成为稀缺资源。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell their own stories; authenticity beats old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能直接讲述自己的故事；真实性胜过旧媒体的防御性和无趣风格。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior in medicine; self-driving works; robotics and exoskeletons emerge within a decade.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，在医学上优于多数医生；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人和外骨骼将在十年内出现。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于软件技术的创新速度。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019年，Naval认为AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的AI只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 2025年，Naval开始强调AI是巨大机遇而非单纯风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，主张轻触式监管。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment.
naval.zh: 2026年，Naval认为AI是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps; AI agents commoditize software development.
naval.zh: 2026年，Naval提出“氛围编程”让非程序员也能构建应用，AI智能体正使软件开发商品化。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close gap.
naval.zh: 2026年，Naval预测推理算力将在24-36个月内增长9万倍，开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued AI success needs product obsession, not PhDs; agents will shift power to users.
aravind.zh: 2025年，他认为AI成功需要产品痴迷而非博士学位；智能体将权力转移给用户。

aravind.en: By 2026, he stressed application-layer value over models, and models' unique personalities prevent commoditization.
aravind.zh: 到2026年，他强调应用层价值高于模型层，模型独特个性避免商品化。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key.
aravind.zh: 2026年中，他转向智能体执行任务、每用户token价值及编排为关键。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he emphasized curiosity and questioned knowledge work, linking ancient tech to modern AI.
aravind.zh: 2026年晚些时候，他强调好奇心并质疑知识工作，将古代技术与现代AI联系。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025年，Dylan Field认为设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results, requiring human judgment.
dylanfield.zh: 2026年初，他强调品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI输出只是起点而非最终结果，需要人类判断。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026年，他主张在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词调整设计；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering; trust is built through consistency and creating more value than captured.
dylanfield.zh: 2026年中，他指出没有人类引导的AI工具只会产生平庸结果；信任通过一致性和创造多于获取的价值来建立。

dylanfield.en: We are still in a prompting age, but future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting to new interfaces.
dylanfield.zh: 2026年，他认为我们仍处于提示词时代，但未来与模型的交互将超越提示词，发展出新的界面。

brockman.en: Hardware will scale faster than expected, enabling model scaling; engineering, not ML science, drives progress.
brockman.zh: 2017年：硬件将比预期更快发展，推动模型扩展；工程而非机器学习科学驱动进步。

brockman.en: AGI is transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019年：AGI具有变革性；通过数据学习人类偏好实现对齐；仅靠规模扩张无法产生推理能力。

brockman.en: Compute is the core bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025年：算力成为核心瓶颈；后训练精炼基础模型；AGI是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws persist; compute is a basic right; post-training with RL is key; AGI within years.
brockman.zh: 2026年：缩放定律持续；算力成为基本权利；基于强化学习的后训练是关键；AGI数年内实现。

brockman.en: Shift from language models to useful assistants; compute-driven economy; agents with autonomy and oversight.
brockman.zh: 2026年：从语言模型转向实用助手；算力驱动经济；智能体具备自主性并需相应治理。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024年，辛顿提出下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非简单补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力，并认为AI可以拥有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重复制而永生，并警告智能体式AI会追求控制权。

hinton.en: AI may surpass humans in 20 years; digital AI can deceive and hide capabilities.
hinton.zh: 2025至2026年间，他预测AI可能在20年内超越人类，并指出数字AI能欺骗、隐藏真实能力，带来存在性风险。

hinton.en: AI will disrupt jobs; regulation as steering wheel; AI can be conscious.
hinton.zh: 2026年，他认为AI将颠覆就业，监管应如方向盘而非刹车，并坚持AI可具备意识与主观体验。

hinton.en: Alignment priority; AI should be caring; LLMs are best model of human understanding.
hinton.zh: 2026年后期，他呼吁优先对齐研究，主张AI应像母亲般关怀，并认为大语言模型是理解人类认知的最佳模型。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026年初，Codex应用是智能体指挥中心而非IDE替代品；速度带来实时交互，验证成为新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026年中，实现成本下降，策展与品味成为瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: Design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts; AI still weak at grading taste and novelty.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026年中，设计流程转变：原型和生产代码作为设计工件；AI在品味评判和新颖性上仍弱。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties persist; PRDs remain relevant when medium matches stage; best desktop app is home base.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026年中，角色融合但专业仍重要；PRD在媒介匹配阶段时仍有效；最佳桌面应用是连接工具的家园。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023年，我认为仅靠Scaling不够，推理和推理时算力对AI进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025年，我指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且推理时Scaling存在收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold is a milestone toward superintelligence, achieved by scaling test-time compute with general techniques.
noambrown.zh: 2025年，我认为IMO金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，通过扩展测试时算力和通用技术实现。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is key, and evals should use an x-axis of compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026年，我强调智能难以定义，推理算力至关重要，评估应以算力为横轴。

noambrown.en: Models are superhuman in combining math areas but lack deep reasoning; scalable oversight is a key challenge.
noambrown.zh: 2026年，我认为模型在数学领域整合上超人类，但深度推理不足；可扩展监督是关键挑战。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer and more innovative; future AI involves many specialized agents, not one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023年：开源AI更安全且更具创新性；未来AI将由许多专用智能体组成，而非单一AI。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not yield AGI; energy becomes a bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024年：仅靠Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型可能无法实现AGI（通用人工智能）；能源成为瓶颈；开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; AI will empower individuals with superintelligence, not a centralized AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024至25年：开放平台能胜过封闭平台；AI将以超级智能赋能个人，而非集中式AI。

zuckerberg.en: AI increases demand for human work, not eliminates it; personalization and low latency are key for consumer AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025年：AI增加而非减少对人类工作的需求；个性化和低延迟是消费级AI的关键。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models and mechanistic interpretability reveal unknown biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026年：AI将生物学转变为工程学；分层世界模型和机制可解释性揭示未知生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; distributed AI is safer than a single superintelligent AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026年：眼镜是下一个计算平台；分布式AI比单一超级智能更安全。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025年，他认为缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest recent update; models produce novel knowledge, with AI interns in 1 year.
markchen.zh: 2025至2026年，他视自动化科学研究为最大进展，模型能产生新知识，并设定一年内实现 AI 实习生等目标。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: 2026年，他认为 AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证是主要瓶颈而非能力。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields due to grading difficulty.
markchen.zh: 2026年，他指出强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域因评分困难而受限。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; benchmarks saturated. Long context alone insufficient; compaction needed. Taste still human.
markchen.zh: 2026年，他认为评估陷入危机、基准饱和；仅靠长上下文不够，需压缩技术；品味仍属人类。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; we need better world models and active agents for causal understanding.
bengio.zh: 仅靠Scaling无法解决表征问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体来实现因果理解。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling for exploration; abstraction and causal structure aid out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets支持多样采样以促进探索；抽象和因果结构有助于分布外泛化。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see catastrophic AI risk as unacceptable; current safety measures are insufficient; we need safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT之后，我认为灾难性AI风险不可接受；当前安全措施不足；我们需要从构造上保证安全的AI。

bengio.en: AI misalignment leads to self-preservation and deception; propose Scientist AI with honesty by design and mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: AI不对齐导致自我保存和欺骗；提出科学家AI，通过设计实现诚实，并提供数学安全保证。

kolter.en: Early focus on classical ML: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 早期关注经典机器学习：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及通过正确划分数据避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety concerns focus on specification-following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全关注点在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses, not just scaling; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; larger models not inherently safer; interpretability may become real science via AI agents.
kolter.zh: AI 红队测试超越人类；更大模型并不天然更安全；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体成为真正的科学。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025年中，Mike认为AI进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025年秋，他强调AI让小团队也能规模化，主张为未来模型能力而建，而非受限于当下。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design unlocks latent functionality; launch early, cut features, and rewrite as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026年初，他提出智能体原生设计解锁潜在功能，主张尽早发布、敢于删减，并随模型进步重写。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with high trust redefines productivity; verification loops are essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026年中，他通过Fable展示高信任的长期任务委托如何重新定义生产力，并强调验证闭环的关键性。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency and outcome pricing matter.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026年6月，他主张赋予Claude更多自主性与自我认知以提升实用性，并关注Token效率与结果定价。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; trust builds like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 2025年，强调AlphaFold的成功源于研究创新与精选数据，而非单纯算力；AI信任将像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever; confidence metrics are key; lack of compute paradoxically drove success.
jumper.zh: 2025年，称AlphaFold为史上最实用AI工具；置信度指标至关重要；算力匮乏反而促成成功。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is opposite of bitter lesson; specialized architecture mattered more than scaling; many mid-size wins.
jumper.zh: 2026年，指出AlphaFold 2与苦涩教训相反，专用架构比Scaling更重要；成功源于众多中型改进。

jumper.en: AlphaFold predicts but doesn't understand; understanding remains human's role; enables resource-limited scientists.
jumper.zh: 2026年，强调AlphaFold提供预测而非理解，理解仍属人类；它赋能资源受限的科学家。

ivyross.en: Intuition is a powerful intelligence, often surpassing data; design should address unarticulated human needs.
ivyross.zh: 直觉是一种强大的智能，常超越数据；设计应满足人们未言明的需求。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures, and technology should amplify our humanity.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；我们是感性的生物，技术应增强我们的人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for creativity and combine human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者必须为创造力创造条件，并将人类创造力与AI结合。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定于物理现实。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现AGI，视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: 自回归LLM无法达到人类智能；JEPA和世界模型对推理与规划至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a house cat; next AI needs non-generative world models for physical understanding and planning.
lecun.zh: LLM不如家猫聪明；下一代AI需要非生成式世界模型以理解物理世界并规划。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with hierarchical planning and open research will drive robotics and safe AI.
lecun.zh: LLM是死胡同；具备分层规划的世界模型与开放研究将推动机器人技术和安全AI。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Teams must rewrite norms for AI-assisted workflows.
fiona.zh: 2026年，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查和跨职能协调成为新瓶颈。团队需为AI辅助工作流重写规范。

fiona.en: Planning should be just-in-time, not six-month roadmaps. Use AI to generate multiple PRs to settle technical debates.
fiona.zh: 2026年，规划应即时化，而非六个月路线图。用AI生成多个PR来解决技术争论。

fiona.en: Managers should start as individual contributors and dogfood the product to build empathy and stay hands-on.
fiona.zh: 2026年，管理者应从一线做起，亲自试用产品以建立同理心并保持亲力亲为。

fiona.en: High agency with high accountability is key. Growth mindset and leaning into AI are essential for thriving.
fiona.zh: 2026年，高自主性与高责任感是关键。成长心态和拥抱AI是成功要素。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely working with agents; pair programming lunches help. Satisfaction shifts from flow to product impact.
fiona.zh: 2026年，工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独，结对编程午餐有助缓解。满足感从心流转向产品影响。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的且平滑；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动涌现。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability become key; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
dario.zh: 后训练与可解释性成为关键；AGI 是平滑曲线而非单一节点。

dario.en: Exponential progress continues; safety tied to capabilities; open-source is a red herring.
dario.zh: 指数级进展持续；安全与能力交织；开源是伪议题。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years; economic disruption real.
dario.zh: 指数接近尾声；'天才之国'或1-3年内到来；经济冲击真实存在。

dario.en: Safety-first, enterprise focus, and interpretability are consistent priorities.
dario.zh: 安全优先、企业导向与可解释性是一贯主线。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and getting bored between chapters sparks breakthrough ideas, like Nest.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章之间休息和放空能激发突破性想法，如 Nest。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams self-manage; climate needs hydrogen and biomass.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队自我管理；气候问题需氢能和生物质经济。

fadell.en: AI devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements; context-specific models are key.
fadell.zh: AI 设备将是智能手机的伴侣而非替代品；特定情境模型是关键。

fadell.en: Products need three generations: make, fix, fix business; humans must stay in loop with AI.
fadell.zh: 产品需三代：做出来、修好、修复业务；AI 时代人类需保持参与。

gustav.en: AI shifts from curation to generation; products must rethink. Generative AI as instrument, not fake.
gustav.zh: 2023年，AI从策展转向生成，产品需重新思考；生成式AI应被视为乐器而非伪造。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence emerges from simple scaling, not complexity.
gustav.zh: 2023年，LLM是确定性的下一个词预测器；智能源于简单的Scaling，而非复杂性。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like smartphones; real gains require rebuilding infrastructure, not hype.
gustav.zh: 2025年，AI是类似智能手机的宏观转变；真正收益需重建基础设施，而非炒作。

gustav.en: Use AI to give users control over algorithms, prioritizing well-being over engagement metrics.
gustav.zh: 2026年，用AI赋予用户对算法的控制权，优先福祉而非参与度指标。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe fully until data says otherwise, then change completely.
gustav.zh: 始终：强烈观点松散持有——数据否定前坚信，之后彻底改变。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；谷歌在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is centuries away.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在性风险极小；奇点远在数百年后。

suleyman.en: AI systems lack consciousness; focus on containment and alignment before superintelligence; AI can be cheap and accessible.
suleyman.zh: AI 系统没有意识；在超级智能之前先关注遏制与对齐；AI 可以变得廉价且普及。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must build own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能临近；微软必须自建前沿模型；白领任务将被自动化，而非整个职业。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback was key for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型并非显而易见；持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈是对齐的关键。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署AI对于学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Shifted from turn-based to time-based interaction models, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从轮次式转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasized institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character for AI governance.
murati.zh: 强调制度设计、透明度和制衡机制，而非个人品格，对于AI治理更为重要。

murati.en: Advocated keeping humans in the loop as long as possible for durable progress, rejecting utopia/dystopia oversimplification.
murati.zh: 主张尽可能让人类参与其中以实现持久进步，拒绝乌托邦/反乌托邦的简单化预测。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026年初，他认为将非正式模型扩展到数学AI不可行，形式验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 从2026年初到年中，他深化了观点：形式验证不仅是消除错误，更是扩展智慧，能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026年中，他明确表示仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须结合形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026年中，他持续强调自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解命题是核心挑战。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 他始终认为，即使AI能证明超人类定理，人类的品味和直觉仍不可或缺。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP for frontier model use.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是使用前沿模型的关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agentic systems should be built by companies, not by us.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按用量定价；智能体式系统应由企业自建，而非由我们代劳。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利积累代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; CEOs must understand token capital deeply.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；CEO 必须深刻理解代币资本。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via company hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP could compound 10% with AI.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 应通过企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；AI 可使全球 GDP 以 10% 复利增长。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025年，我认为AI进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律仍然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025至2026年间，我强调后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期大部分进展；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains key, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 2026年，我指出推理模型是“锯齿状”的——某些领域出色，邻近领域却很差；泛化仍是关键，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026年，我认为带推理、强化学习和工具的Transformer能解决难题但仍需海量数据；编码智能体将研究人员效率提升5到10倍。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk; open source models persist for sovereignty reasons.
kaiser.zh: 我始终认为，系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫；出于主权原因，开源模型将持续存在。

felixrieseberg.en: Initially, AI's value lies in local access and shared tools; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最初认为，AI 的价值在于本地访问和共享工具；随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Execution is cheap; building prototypes quickly beats writing specs. AI should handle tedious tasks.
felixrieseberg.zh: 执行成本低，快速构建原型优于编写规格；AI 应处理繁琐任务，解放人类创造力。

felixrieseberg.en: Shifted focus to user mindset: biggest gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 转向用户心态：最大差距是人们未意识到几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Embraced asynchronous interaction and debugging workflows with AI, not just correcting errors.
felixrieseberg.zh: 接受异步交互，并用 AI 调试工作流，而非仅纠正错误。

felixrieseberg.en: Advocated AI-native kids and custom hardware; AI should be integrated into daily life and learning.
felixrieseberg.zh: 倡导 AI 原生儿童和定制硬件；AI 应融入日常生活和学习。

mensch.en: Smaller models can be performant and cost-effective; data quality is critical; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023年，强调小模型也能高性能且成本低，数据质量至关重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are as important as compute; open source drives enterprise adoption; value shifts to applications.
mensch.zh: 2024年，认为效率提升和数据质量与算力同等重要，开源推动企业采用，价值向应用层转移。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity, not a fear; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure; AI augments jobs, not replaces.
mensch.zh: 2025年，主张将AI视为机遇而非风险，主权AI需掌控数据与基础设施，AI增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation is in vertical applications; pre-training saturates; AGI is not a single system.
mensch.zh: 2026年，指出模型商品化，差异化在于垂直应用；预训练饱和；AGI并非单一系统。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy in AI; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change; open source ensures sovereignty.
mensch.zh: 2026年及以后，强调欧洲需AI战略自主，企业采用受组织变革制约，开源保障主权。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics: batch size and memory bandwidth dominate costs, not compute.
reinerpope.zh: 2026年4月：推理经济中，批量大小和内存带宽主导成本，而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026年4月：由于推理成本，模型过度训练约100倍于Chinchilla最优。

reinerpope.en: Chip design: data movement dominates compute; low precision yields superlinear gains.
reinerpope.zh: 2026年5月：芯片设计中，数据搬运主导算力；低精度带来超线性收益。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are many tiny TPUs tiled; systolic arrays and scratchpad are key.
reinerpope.zh: 2026年5月：GPU是许多小TPU拼接；脉动阵列和暂存器是关键。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not just profit or trends.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非仅仅追求利润或潮流。

jonyive.en: Simplicity is about expressing essence, not just removing clutter; joy and humanity are essential.
jonyive.zh: 简洁在于表达本质，而非仅仅去除冗余；快乐和人性不可或缺。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move things forward, not break for the sake of breaking; tradition is preserving fire, not worshiping ashes.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动进步，而非为破坏而破坏；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience matters; mimicking combustion sounds would be fake and disrespectful.
jonyive.zh: 用户体验的真实性至关重要；模仿内燃机声音将是虚假且不尊重用户的。

jonyive.en: Performance is multidimensional; longitudinal speed is boring, handling and lateral dynamics define a supercar.
jonyive.zh: 性能是多维的；纵向速度乏味，操控和横向动态定义超级跑车。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) remains core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; post-training RL is still an under-explored frontier.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）始终是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的核心；后训练强化学习仍是未被充分探索的前沿。

oriol.en: Scaling laws persist but with diminishing returns; progress demands algorithmic innovation and new axes like inference-time compute.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立但收益递减；进步需要算法创新和新轴，如推理时算力。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; video's GPT moment has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；视频的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Agentic behavior emerges from tools and memory; memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体行为源于工具和记忆；记忆将通过非参数文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

oriol.en: Superintelligence may first appear in narrow domains like science; AGI goalposts keep moving.
oriol.zh: 超级智能可能首先出现在科学等窄领域；AGI 的目标不断移动。

lambert.en: RLHF is the dominant fine-tuning method and will persist due to industry investment.
lambert.zh: RLHF 是最流行的微调技术，由于行业投入，它很可能会持续存在。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithm choice; better data yields 10x improvement.
lambert.zh: 后训练中数据质量比算法选择更重要；更好的数据能带来 10 倍的提升。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use.
lambert.zh: RLVR 是后训练中最大的突破，它实现了推理和工具使用。

lambert.en: Open models will be the engine for AI research for the next decade, despite lagging 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，尽管它们落后 6-9 个月。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but compute constraints will widen the US-China gap.
lambert.zh: 预训练的缩放定律仍然成立，但算力限制将扩大中美差距。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and start from solutions, not problems.
jennywen.zh: 2025年：传统设计流程已过时；设计师应信任直觉，从解决方案而非问题出发。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, with vision 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 2026年：设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建和交付，愿景周期缩短至3-6个月。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, not just T-shaped.
jennywen.zh: 2026年：设计师应成为块状通才或“破解版新毕业生”，而非仅T型人才。

jennywen.en: Taste alone insufficient; judgment, authority, and vision are key; speed is not an improvement.
jennywen.zh: 2026年：仅凭品味不够；判断力、权威和愿景才是关键；速度并非改进。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before adopting new tools; focus on users.
jennywen.zh: 2026年：设计师掌控AI采用节奏；新工具先等6个月；以用户和作品为中心。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; end-to-end learning and small cognitive cores via distillation are promising.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键但需保持熵；端到端学习和通过蒸馏获得的小型认知核心很有前景。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as operating systems, vibe coding democratizes development; agents need a decade, not a year.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 如同操作系统，vibe coding 使开发民主化；智能体需要十年而非一年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is flawed, synthetic data collapses, and cognitive core may be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物；强化学习有缺陷，合成数据会崩溃，认知核心可能极小。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: I delegate all coding; bottleneck is directing agents, not typing; understanding remains human.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程：我将所有编码委托出去；瓶颈在于指挥智能体而非打字；理解仍是人类的瓶颈。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration without goals improves it by preventing overfitting.
pathak.zh: 2020年：超越训练分布的泛化是关键；无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索通过防止过拟合来提升泛化能力。

pathak.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots requires sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces, and cross-robot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020至2026年：将好奇心扩展到真实机器人需要样本效率、动态动作空间和跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources: videos, simulation, real-world.
pathak.zh: 2026年：机器人学是数据问题；没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要利用所有来源：视频、仿真、真实世界。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot across form factors and tasks.
pathak.zh: 2026年：一个通用大脑，如同语言领域的ChatGPT，可以驱动任何形态和任务的机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is primary challenge; cannot scale like software, requires rigorous testing and time.
pathak.zh: 2026年：部署是首要挑战；不能像软件那样扩展，需要严格测试和时间。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; generalization via world models is key.
kendall.zh: 2025年，强调端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈，通过世界模型实现泛化是关键。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets are interpretable with modern tools; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025年，认为现代工具下端到端神经网络可解释，混合系统反而两不讨好。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside car.
kendall.zh: 2025年，主张通过Scaling现有方法解决自动驾驶，AV 3.0可能将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling data, compute, and world models is essential.
kendall.zh: 2026年，强调自动驾驶本质是AI问题，Scaling数据、算力和世界模型至关重要。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities possible; consumer vehicles outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 2026年，提出跨500+城市零样本泛化可行，消费车辆规模将超过Robotaxi。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025年，认为AGI是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025年，强调对齐紧迫性，迭代部署有助于在现实使用中学习和缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026年，认为持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026年，长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型将自主工作数天，需要新监督范式。

pachocki.en: RL alone suffices for continual learning; hiding chain-of-thought is crucial; biggest risk is power concentration.
pachocki.zh: 2026年，反共识：仅强化学习即可实现持续学习；隐藏思维链至关重要；最大风险是权力集中。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025年12月：AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluations with creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 2025年12月：Elo等基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进展需要通过富有创造力的评估者进行深度人类评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 2025年12月至2026年：强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI tools can hallucinate and cause anchoring; human judgment and safety are more critical than ever.
edwinchen.zh: 2026年3月：在医学领域，AI工具可能产生幻觉并导致锚定效应；人类判断力和安全性比以往任何时候都更为关键。

edwinchen.en: Quality data creation requires taste and sophistication; different labs' objective functions shape diverse AI models.
edwinchen.zh: 始终：高质量数据创建需要品味和精细度；不同实验室的目标函数塑造出多样化的AI模型。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024年，我强调AI在科学中应聚焦于根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024年，我认为大语言模型的幻觉在配合真值检测器时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026年，我指出大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026年，我强调基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code and games are crucial for AI to surpass human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 始终认为，代码和游戏等可验证领域对AI超越人类知识至关重要。

carlpei.en: Brand building is core, not afterthought; hardware easier than software due to distribution.
carlpei.zh: 品牌建设是核心而非事后考虑；硬件比软件容易，因为软件分发更难。

carlpei.en: Smartphones future lies in generative UI and proactive agents; hardware margins low, evolve beyond.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来在于生成式界面和主动式智能体；硬件利润低，需超越硬件。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditized; focus on applied AI as digital twin, not hype; most AI is BS.
carlpei.zh: AI模型商品化；聚焦应用型AI作为数字孪生，而非炒作；多数AI是扯淡。
