carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature categories; AI as ingredient for utility, not marketing.
carlpei.zh: 设计在成熟品类中实现差异化；AI作为实用性的成分，而非营销噱头。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interface could; apps will disappear.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜取代；只有脑机接口可能；应用将消失。

turley.en: Initially, ChatGPT was an accidental hackathon demo; product success requires shipping fast and iterating based on real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 起初，ChatGPT 是黑客松的意外产物；产品成功需要快速发布并根据真实反馈迭代。

turley.en: Chat is not the final interface; future AI will render its own UI and integrate into tools, like moving from MS-DOS to Windows.
turley.zh: 聊天不是最终界面；未来 AI 将生成自己的 UI 并融入工具，如同从 MS-DOS 到 Windows 的演进。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离：前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应尽可能加速。

turley.en: By 2026, focus shifted to long-term retention and proactive assistants; growth driven by friction removal, product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 到 2026 年，重点转向长期留存和主动式助手；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Pricing and distribution strategies evolved: subscriptions shaped demand, and distribution alone wasn't enough; power users drive discovery.
turley.zh: 定价和分发策略演变：订阅用于塑造需求，仅靠分发不够；核心用户推动发现。

nando.en: AI should augment human abilities; generalist agents like Gato tokenizing all inputs are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023年，主张AI应像显微镜和望远镜一样扩展人类能力，并认为像Gato这样将所有输入token化的通用智能体是迈向AGI的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video (e.g., YouTube) is promising for training agents without expensive RL, echoing human learning.
nando.zh: 2023年，提出从视频（如YouTube）中学习是训练智能体的有前途途径，无需昂贵的强化学习，类似人类学习方式。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest open challenges; no solutions yet, requiring global collaboration.
nando.zh: 2026年，强调AI安全与负责任部署是最大的开放性挑战，尚无解决方案，需要全球合作。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues in AI, with unique advantages; local language models can revolutionize education.
nando.zh: 2026年，指出非洲在AI领域跨越式发展，具有独特优势；本地语言模型可革新教育。

nando.en: Human skills like communication are as important as coding; research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems.
nando.zh: 2026年，认为沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要；研究需拥抱失败并简化问题。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023年，强调具身对AI落地与减少幻觉至关重要，认为LLM因缺乏具身体验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, providing infinite data for pre-training.
jimfan.zh: 2023年，主张模拟是训练具身智能体的关键，为预训练提供无限数据，弥补互联网高质量token的不足。

jimfan.en: Data bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 2026年，指出机器人学的主要瓶颈是数据，合成数据（通过模拟和世界模型生成）是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test (robot cleaning messy house) is grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026年，提出物理图灵测试（机器人整理凌乱房间）作为具身AI的终极挑战，强调系统一（低层控制）最难。

jimfan.en: Robot foundation models via simple end-to-end learning; GPT-3 moment in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 2026年，主张通过简单端到端模型构建机器人基础模型，并预测机器人领域的GPT-3时刻将在约5年内到来，但家用落地需更长时间。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence and solving onboarding.
sholto.zh: 2024年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能提升智能并解决上手问题。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is key; pre-training plus RL may reach AGI without new breakthroughs by 2027-28.
sholto.zh: 2025年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键；预训练加强化学习或可在2027-28年无需新突破即可实现AGI。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator; agents' reliability over time horizon matters more than raw capability.
sholto.zh: 2025年，我认为编程是领先指标；智能体在时间跨度上的可靠性比原始能力更重要。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (30h) expands achievements; simplest RL methods work best.
sholto.zh: 2025至2026年，我视强化学习为新扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性（30小时）扩展成就；最简单的强化学习方法最有效。

sholto.en: Capability overhang exists; managing agent teams and compute supply are bottlenecks; software-only singularity possible.
sholto.zh: 2026年，我认为存在能力过剩；管理智能体团队和算力供应是瓶颈；软件单点奇点可能实现。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024年，强调设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度和熟悉度，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南应是动态平台，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and invest early in brand.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026年，将设计提升为战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用，并尽早投资品牌。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow and collaborate.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师自主权以促进成长与协作。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic feedback and gut decisions over data-driven processes.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026年，反对结构化设计评审，偏好即时反馈和直觉决策，而非数据驱动流程。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023年，我认为仅靠Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题；拥有更好数据和算法的小模型可以超越大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 2023年至2025年间，我强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不够，后训练（post-training）结合RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, so we need to explore unknown knowledge.
yejin.zh: 2025年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈；当前AI只是内插人类知识，因此需要探索未知知识。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be used during pre-training to improve reasoning, not just as post-training.
yejin.zh: 2025年至2026年，我提出强化学习（reinforcement learning）不仅用于后训练，也可在预训练阶段提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet; small models with diverse synthetic data can rival frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2026年，我认为多元对齐（pluralistic alignment）优于消除互联网偏见；使用多样化合成数据的小模型可以媲美前沿模型（frontier model）。

leike.en: AI safety research is under-explored; focus on empirical methods and skill-building, not just math genius.
leike.zh: 2018年：AI安全研究尚待充分探索；应重视实证方法与技能培养，而非仅靠数学天赋。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability to align superintelligence.
leike.zh: 2023年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展；需要可扩展监督与可解释性来对齐超级智能。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient; external oversight needed.
leike.zh: 2024年：OpenAI安全文化退化；仅靠后训练不足；需要外部监管。

truell.en: Initially, natural language won't be the primary coding interface; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 2024年，我认为自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024年，缩放定律预测进展，但测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Evolved from viewing agents as promising but not yet useful to emphasizing iterative human-AI collaboration and higher-level intent specification.
truell.zh: 从2024年到2025年，我从认为智能体有前景但尚不实用，转向强调迭代式人机协作和更高层次的意图规范。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design become more valuable.
truell.zh: 2025年，我认为编程将从代码转向意图规范，人类主导；品味和逻辑设计将更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost; every magic moment involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 始终认为，定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其关乎速度和成本；每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields intelligence, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是AI完备的；通过算力和数据扩展可获得智能，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Scaling laws persist, but algorithmic advances and inference-time compute scaling are equally vital; data isn't scarce with better objectives.
shazeer.zh: 2025年，他坚持缩放定律，但强调算法进步和推理时算力扩展同样关键；通过更好的训练目标，数据并非稀缺。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture-of-experts for efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025年，他预测未来模型需处理万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Agentic learning via actions in the world and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI, not just passive data observation.
shazeer.zh: 2025年，他转向强调智能体式学习（通过在世界中行动）和强化学习对AGI的关键作用，而非被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: AI safety needs engineering safeguards and human oversight; open-source models narrow gap with frontier models, accelerating progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025年，他重申AI安全需工程防护和人类监督；开源模型缩小与前沿模型的差距，加速整体进展。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are powerful for robot skill acquisition; RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018年，强调自我对弈和模仿学习对机器人技能获取的强大作用，同时指出强化学习缺乏层级推理以应对长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL boosts sample efficiency; hard-coding prior knowledge is limiting; pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021年，主张将无监督学习与强化学习结合以大幅提升样本效率，反对将先验知识硬编码进网络，并发现预训练语言模型可迁移推理能力到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistently values learning from data over hand-coded rules, and aims for generality across tasks and domains.
abbeel.zh: 始终重视从数据中学习而非手工规则，并追求跨任务和领域的通用性。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师并统一问题认知来推动工作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, fluctuating and paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，会波动，并与技术债务一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Treat AI as a creative partner; jam with it openly without rigid structure.
nadchishtie.zh: 将AI视为创意伙伴，开放地与其即兴合作，不拘泥于固定结构。

nadchishtie.en: Future design tools are interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 未来的设计工具应互操作，以代码为唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Legacy design tools from the 90s are outdated; AI enables genuine progress.
nadchishtie.zh: 90年代的传统设计工具已过时；AI带来真正的进步。

nadchishtie.en: Users are willing to self-educate on technical concepts if empowered.
nadchishtie.zh: 用户在被赋能时愿意自学技术概念。

nadchishtie.en: Being too visionary and betting on future model capabilities can lead to failure.
nadchishtie.zh: 过于远见并押注未来模型能力可能导致失败。

nadchishtie.en: Entire functions like PM, research, sales can collapse and merge in AI-first companies.
nadchishtie.zh: 在AI优先的公司中，PM、研究、销售等整个职能可能瓦解并合并。

nadchishtie.en: Design and engineering are two sides of the same coin; AI merges them further.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计与工程是一体两面；AI进一步融合二者。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 拥有端到端执行能力并利用AI填补空白的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process documentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应优先展示工艺和意图，而非过程文档。

nadchishtie.en: Hiring managers look for high-slope individuals with intrinsic drive and learning aptitude.
nadchishtie.zh: 招聘经理寻找具有内在驱动力和学习能力的高斜率人才。

nadchishtie.en: Side projects can outweigh traditional experience if they demonstrate care and skill.
nadchishtie.zh: 如果展示出用心和技能，副项目可能胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Paid test work provides more signal than any other interview stage.
nadchishtie.zh: 付费测试工作比其他任何面试阶段提供更多信号。

nadchishtie.en: Cross-functional squads with 8-10 people are suboptimal; small teams work better.
nadchishtie.zh: 8-10人的跨职能团队并非最优；小团队效果更好。

nadchishtie.en: IC tracks and specialist pigeonholing can limit growth; generalists often outperform.
nadchishtie.zh: 个人贡献者轨道和专家定位可能限制成长；通才往往表现更优。

nadchishtie.en: Over-explaining process in portfolios can hurt candidates by revealing biases.
nadchishtie.zh: 在作品集中过度解释过程可能因暴露偏见而损害候选人。

nadchishtie.en: Metrics and quantifiable impact are not heavily weighted due to goal-setting difficulty.
nadchishtie.zh: 由于目标设定困难，指标和可量化影响并未被高度重视。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用AI已成为预期；不采用如同早期忽视互联网。
